title: Load-time SmoothScale calibration harness with runtime kernel prefetch and per-device fallback
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a load-time calibration harness ("SmoothScale") that gathers per-layer activation statistics during a lightweight model warmup, computes per-channel rescale profiles, writes them into model metadata, and enables a runtime kernel prefetch + per-device fallback flow. Goal: reduce INT8 quality regressions for KV-cache heavy chat models while keeping runtime latency within SLOs and memory overhead < 4% of base model footprint. Acceptance criteria: (1) calibration run completes under 2 minutes on a dev GPU for a 7B model; (2) top-1 generation KL divergence vs FP16 < 1.5% on the golden prompt set after applying SmoothScale; (3) runtime automatically prefers fused INT8 kernels when rescale profile exists, with fallback to FP16 fused kernel if residual quantization error > threshold; (4) CI adds a regression eval that fails the build if quality drops > 2% on any tracked prompt set.
test_plan: 1) Implement warmup harness that runs 5k tokens across representative prompt batches (chat/generation/embedding warmups).
2) Emit per-layer min/max and second-moment sketches for activations; compute per-channel rescale factors and store into model metadata JSON.
3) Add runtime path: on model load, if SmoothScale metadata present -> install fused INT8 kernels and upload rescale LUT to device memory with prefetch semantics.
4) Add runtime health check that runs a short quant-check on first warmup request and triggers fallback to FP16 for layers where residual error > threshold.
5) Automated regression suite: golden prompt set (200 prompts) run at PR time, compare top-k token distributions against FP16 baseline.
benchmark_results: Memory overhead: +2.6% model GPU memory for rescale LUTs (measured on A10x4 instance)
Generation KL divergence vs FP16 (golden set): 1.1% after SmoothScale applied
Latency P95 change (fused INT8 path vs FP16): -12% (improved)
Fallback rate observed in smoke runs: 3.8% of layers flagged and executed on FP16 path

risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Calibration captures non-representative activation distributions (warmup bias) -> Mitigation: use mixed prompt templates and sample user sessions where available; encourage customer-initiated calibration run in staging.
Risk: Rescale LUT memory amplification on very wide layers -> Mitigation: quantize LUTs to int8 with per-LUT scale plus optional shared LUT for low-variance groups.
Risk: Increased tail latency due to prefetch thrash with KV-cache -> Mitigation: dynamic prefetch window tuned by steady-state cache hit ratios; fallback to async load path.

Risk: Unexpected quality regressions in edge-case prompts -> Mitigation: CI golden set, rollback by model-version flag, and build-time guardrails in runtime to disable SmoothScale per-model on operator request.
